pages.text: [#](53341a)Hedgecraft made deliberate. Where Mutandis scatters possibilities, the sprig forces a few changes with a steady hand. Each use wears it down.[#]()
pages.title: Mutating Sprig

pages.text: [#](53341a)Surround an **Ent Twig** with **Mutandis Extremis** at a table. Or use the cauldron: heat a filled Witch's Cauldron near an altar, drop in an **Ent Twig** and a **Nether Wart**, then use Mutandis Extremis on it.[#]()
pages.title: Making the Sprig

pages.text: [#](53341a)On simple blocks the sprig flips **Grass Block** and **Mycelium** either way, and turns underwater **Dirt** to **Clay** and back.[#]() [#](53341a)An empty **Chest** over water with Short Grass on four sides becomes four **Grasspers**.[#]()
pages.title: Block & Built Mutations

pages.text: [#](53341a)A **Trapped Chest** ringed with Vines over water becomes a **Leech Chest**. A Leech Chest ringed with Poppies leaves four **Blood Poppies**.[#]()

[#](53341a)A **Cobweb** over water, with four planted Alder Saplings and a trapped Zombie, becomes four **Critter Snares** — the bridge into bat, slime, and magma snare chains. Four bat snares packed with Slime Balls make a **Concentrated Bat Ball**.[#]()
pages.title: Creature Snares

pages.text: [#](53341a)The diagonal Grasspers mostly hold Mutandis Extremis and a Charged Attuned Stone. Bat snares around a lured Wolf become **Owls**. Slime snares around an Ocelot become **Toads**. Cocoa-ringed webs with a Wolf and Owl leave a wild **Flying Monkey**.[#]()
pages.title: Living Mutations

pages.text: [#](53341a)A **Cactus** on sand, ringed with water and Spanish Moss and fed Bone Meal/Blaze Powder Grasspers, becomes **Wild Bramble**. The same with **Sugar Cane** and Ender Pearls makes **Void Bramble**.[#]()
pages.title: Brambles & Wormwood

pages.text: [#](53341a)Ripe **Wheat** ringed with Wispy Cotton leaves a young **Wormwood**.[#]()
